notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
It has been 1 year since the launch of Homebound Haerold. A game I really only made for the sake of making it and it being crudely offensive. Truthfully I didn't really wanted make this game but with little to no other resources to make what I really wanted, I felt tired and just made a game regardless of what i wanted. Even now there is no resources for what i really want to do but despite that I wanted to announce that I am working on a new small title.

Firstly: I will work on a little something in between Homebound Haerold and its eventual sequel. And It wont be racist, stupid or poorly done this time around so i hope this next project will bring some more attention this time Around. Though it will lack my Genuine Motivation I will Carry on to start and finish it.

Secondly: I will be putting the games soundtrack in the game files so anyone can listen to these short crappy little tunes I made. Even a little artwork for said Soundtrack. 

The Update will occur shortly onwards.
